title: Suggestions register — site and decision-making improvements, best path chosen before building

suggestions.title: Show price tier and opening/closing status on every market row
suggestions.problem: Readers cannot tell official numbers from bookmaker numbers at row level.

options.label: Section footers only (status quo)
options.tradeoff: cheap, keeps the ambiguity that the user flagged

suggestions.why: The brief demands per-row sources and flags; a footer is not a source link.

suggestions.title: Publish signal and staking as two scored blocks with luck-removed ROI
suggestions.problem: A lucky staking run can mask a bad signal when ROI is one number.

options.label: Two blocks: flat-stake signal metrics + staking metrics, luck rule applied to signal
Single ROI column with footnoted luck note

suggestions.why: Directly what the user asked for; luck rule already defined (28-0 etc.) and now applied to the signal block.

suggestions.title: Decision-usable correlation set = official numbers only, n on every value
suggestions.problem: Mirror-derived correlations were mixed into the same page as official ones.

options.label: Official block first with n; research blocks flagged and suppressed from decisions
Merge all, flag inline
options.tradeoff: easy to misread in a hurry

suggestions.why: Requirement is explicit: compute from official numbers, publish n; research stays useful but never decides.

suggestions.title: Track replacement depth (2nd/3rd/4th string) on every deficiency row and in rollups
suggestions.problem: The register said a replacement exists but not how deep the drop was.

options.label: depth column + depth_label + per-unit rollups
options.tradeoff: small build, answers the question asked

suggestions.why: The user asked for the depth itself, tracked, not prose.

suggestions.title: Fix origination order side -> total -> moneyline and publish fair/market/difference as three columns
suggestions.problem: Edges were mixed with model lines in single wide columns.

options.label: Origination ledger with explicit order + three columns

suggestions.why: Keeps the existing CSV stable and gives the brief exactly the requested shape.

suggestions.title: Confirm or amend the pre-registered demotion thresholds (G-13)
suggestions.problem: Thresholds were pre-registered as defaults; the owner should confirm before any strategy goes live.
suggestions.why: Defaults are conservative and pre-registered before any live result exists.

suggestions.title: Decide on a licensed odds feed vs free snapshots (Q-31)
suggestions.problem: No official price source exists; CLV and trigger D-2 need opening numbers.

options.label: Stay on free fingerprinted snapshots, keep F-06 flags
Collect own snapshots going forward (weekly opening/close capture)
options.tradeoff: labor, builds the snapshot store honestly over time

suggestions.why: Self-collected weekly snapshots fill the opening/closing store without licensing questions.

flagged_reasons: S-20 and S-21 await owner decision

note: Each suggestion lists 2-3 paths with tradeoffs and one recommended path before anything is implemented; implemented ones record status. The review board is the GitHub repository Issues + Pull requests.
